design_goal: Remove logical load_index increment/bounds/segment*28/subtract and slot*28/add from the accepted ring RAM read-data cone without adding any externally visible clock
recommendation: After both frozen layouts naturally finish and root admission, validate the combined stride32 plus11bit private cursor as one structural candidate; use compact-cursor only if measured memory placement cost rejects padding

slot_roles.slot: live4 at first capture, then frozen4

exact_data_contract.clip_rule: Only logical segment0 is clipped to signed +/-409600. Segment5 uses the same newest physical slot as segment0 but remains raw history.
exact_data_contract.old_new_memory_relation: For0<=slot<6 and0<=lane<28: newRAM[(slot<<5)|lane] == oldRAM[slot*28+lane], including arbitrary24bit/X initial values. No relation is imposed on hole words.
exact_data_contract.holes: Each32word slot has lanes28..31 unused. All writes and accepted read requests use lane0..27; holes are never consumers, never initialized as a proof shortcut.

changes: Only enabled ring branch: frame_mem depth168->192; write address becomes concatenated work_slot and original5bit lane
Add private read_segment3/read_lane5/read_slot3 registers. Original work/live/frozen33bits remain unchanged.
First-word speculative read selects live4,lane0. Other reads select private cursor. Direct concatenation is the physical RAM address.
Original lane values/divider/write clocks, live COMMIT order and qualified frozen-pointer writes are unchanged; no memory reset/INIT.
Clip decision comes from first-word phase or read_segment==0, never physical slot equality. Segment6 is an invalid sentinel producing0 after the final prefetch.
Add two narrow wires to observer: peek_first=(state==SNAPSHOT), deliberately not health/deadline-qualified; advance only on the same accepted LOAD0..166 edge that captures snapshot_word.

Keep original fully-qualified frame_freeze, snapshot_word capture enables, core write enable/address/history, all fiveFSM states, load_index8, tick_count, accepted_id, STOP/fault/deadline ordering and publication cycles.
Existing frame_read_index may remain for default/reference branch, but the new cursor-enabled ring data address must have no combinational dependency on it.
Connect two narrow phase/advance wires only. Keep sensor_age/ready/enable/core reset/action/IR/SAFE/lease contracts unchanged.

edge_schedule.before: All28 words in work_slot are already written
edge_schedule.after: Original live pointer update and frame_valid=1. No new externally visible transaction. Next first-word read uses already registered live4.

edge_schedule.before: Policy SNAPSHOT and qualified frame_freeze. peek_first reads old live4,lane0 combinationally; no new reader FF is required to supply this first word.
edge_schedule.after: Original snapshot_word captures word0; frozen0..4 copy old live0..4. Private cursor becomes segment0/lane1/slot old live4. Policy entersLOAD index0.

edge_schedule.before: Core writes OLD snapshot_word as logical wordj. Cursor describes logical wordj+1 before the edge.
edge_schedule.after: snapshot_word captures wordj+1; private cursor advances to wordj+2 using its own small state, independently of load_index data decode.

edge_schedule.before: Prefetch consumes lane27 of the current segment
edge_schedule.after: Set lane0 and next segment. On these boundaries choose respectively frozen0,frozen1,frozen2,frozen3,frozen4 for the following cycle.

edge_schedule.before: Core writes word166; cursor segment5/lane27 reads word167
edge_schedule.after: snapshot_word captures word167; cursor becomes segment6 invalid sentinel, without addressing a hole.

edge_schedule.before: Core writes OLD word167; original frame_read_index would be168
edge_schedule.after: snapshot_word held; no advance/read consumer; original START follows on its original edge.

edge_schedule.edge: reset, disable, stale sensor, policy fault or deadline on any edge
edge_schedule.before: Use original common reset and original capture/advance permission
edge_schedule.after: Original abort/core-reset/actions-zero priority dominates; no private counter completion can publish or rearm. A later legal E_freeze overwrites all cursor bits before any acceptedLOAD.

first_word_and_qualification.true_commit: Keep original frame_freeze=SNAPSHOT&&frame_valid&&run_ok&&!deadline_missed for frozen pointer capture and existing snapshot capture
first_word_and_qualification.speculative_selector: peek_first is only state==SNAPSHOT; it may expose an unaccepted old/X RAM word while waiting or aborted. It must not write pointers, advance state, authorize motion or bypass a capture enable.
first_word_and_qualification.exact_public_relation: On every accepted E_freeze, both original and new read live4,lane0. On acceptedLOAD, cursor and frozen pointer invariant gives the same word. Outside accepted consumption only this private observer/policy read wire may differ.
first_word_and_qualification.scope: Paired observer+policy instance only. Preserve default flat branch and do not claim generic arbitrary external frame_read_index/frame_freeze module equivalence.
first_word_and_qualification.not_the_old_H2_only: H2 alone changes the health/freeze selector but leaves load_index->segment multiply/subtract, which PNR53 actually made worst. The cursor is essential to this proposal.

private_cursor_reset_and_priority.reset: Use the original observer asynchronous reset for the11new cursor bits: segment6 invalid sentinel, lane0, slot0. Do not reset/initialize the RAM or change existing pointer/reset roots.
private_cursor_reset_and_priority.priority: Original observer reset > qualified frame_freeze&&initialized initializes all cursor fields > qualified accepted LOAD0..166 advances > hold
private_cursor_reset_and_priority.no_extra_valid_FF: segment6 represents inactive/past-end; no twelfth cursor-valid FF is required
private_cursor_reset_and_priority.source_qualified_advance: state==LOAD && load_index!=167 && run_ok && !deadline_missed; this wire terminates at cursor FF control, not a live address arithmetic input
private_cursor_reset_and_priority.accepted_output_scope: Any reset/idle speculative read-wire differences are internal to the paired provider/consumer; all original accepted core writes, faults, actions and public publication edges must match.

source_resource_estimates_not_mapping.meaning: Actual current primitive inventory, not new candidate measurement

source_resource_estimates_not_mapping.remaining_address_math: slot*28+lane remains, including first word; segment*28 and logical-index subtraction disappear from RAM path
source_resource_estimates_not_mapping.not_guaranteed: Tool may infer different arithmetic or share existing FFs; no measured gain yet

source_resource_estimates_not_mapping.variant: B: stride32 plus private segment/lane/slot, recommended combined candidate
source_resource_estimates_not_mapping.remaining_read_math: RAM bank output selection and existing current clipping remain; small counter increment logic terminates at private FF D, not RAM RAD.
source_resource_estimates_not_mapping.reset_load: At most11 new cursor reset loads if using original observer reset. No reset-load removal saving is credited.
source_resource_estimates_not_mapping.not_guaranteed: 72cells assumes full192x24 distributed shape is retained; optimizer hole pruning/packing and totalLUT/FF/DSP/CLS require actual mapping.

source_resource_estimates_not_mapping.remaining_address_math: Logical frame_read_index still needs /28 segment and index-segment*28. In particular the measured n22100_s may remain.

source_resource_estimates_not_mapping.variant: Optional compact fully registered address cursor, only if padding proves costly
source_resource_estimates_not_mapping.breakdown: segment3+lane5+linear-address8=16; optional precomputed first live-base8 adds8. Constant base selection/update occurs before use.
source_resource_estimates_not_mapping.remaining_address_math: Original write address slot*28 remains; first-word base must be precomputed at COMMIT or supplied by a constant lookup bypass.

concrete_rejected_shortcuts.counterexample: Logical index28 must be history0/lane0. Low5bits28 point to a hole; index32 should be lane4 but low5bits0 reads another word.

concrete_rejected_shortcuts.shortcut: Capture a new read address only at E_freeze and use it for word0 on that same edge
concrete_rejected_shortcuts.counterexample: Nonblocking FF Q changes after the edge. snapshot_word sees the OLD address/word, causing a stale first word or requiring a forbidden extra clock.
LOAD0 writes word0 then captures word0 again; LOAD1 incorrectly writes a duplicate0 instead of1. Initial private prefetch is lane1.
The source prefetch is one word ahead. The boundary must be after LOAD26 consumes word27 for preload; waiting until LOAD27 reads a hole or repeats the wrong word.

concrete_rejected_shortcuts.shortcut: Use physical newest-slot equality to enable clip
concrete_rejected_shortcuts.counterexample: First28 current words and last28 history words refer to the same slot. A raw value500000 must be current409600 but history500000. First-history repetition makes all five history pointers equal and must still remain raw.

concrete_rejected_shortcuts.shortcut: Copy old frozen pointers into a second private table on E_freeze
concrete_rejected_shortcuts.counterexample: Same-edge nonblocking updates read the previous frozen generation. Subsequent history can select the prior snapshot; use original live->frozen commit and read the updated frozen table at later boundaries.

proof_obligations_before_any_new_mapping: Memory bijection over all6slots x28valid lanes with arbitrary24bit initial/data values; holes never consumed; write clock/lane_value unchanged
Induction on accepted E_freeze/LOAD: cursor describes logical j+1, slot follows frozen4/0/1/2/3/4 order, lane0..27, segment6 only after final prefetch
First COMMIT with !initialized repeats one frame in all5history roles; subsequent6slot wrap and repeated pointers retain exact history and current-only clipping
Reset/disable/stale/fault/deadline exactly at COMMIT, E_freeze, LOAD26/27,54/55,138/139,166/167; no old cursor rearm or publicX acceptance

Original real4500 comparison:168accepted input words,425trace values,6actions, frameID, capture/load/start/publish edges, including interrupted/rearmed and clipping extrema. No inference substitute or forced/zeroed private RAM
Actual mapping: direct FF/phase-to-RAD concatenation; no segment/slot multiply or logical-index subtract in accepted read-address cone; prove relevant write/read/CE and all 24bit lane wiring
Report actual total FF/LUT/SSRAM/BSRAM/DSP/CLS. Only actual subsequent routed paths determine improvement; do not claim either variant fixes NAV/PID/CPU negative paths
